system.description:
Will Amp

When you enter your Crash state, by spending 1 Focus, you become a Maelstrom. You can benefit from two stances from Shift Tides at once, and once per turn, when you deal Cold damage to a creature with a Water Release Ninjutsu, you can inflict one of the affected creatures with Tidal Draw until the beginning of your next turn.
system.summary: Crash, plus two Shift Tides stances at once and Tidal Draw from Water Release cold damage once per turn.

rules.text: Two Shift Tides stances at once; once per turn, Water Release cold damage can inflict Tidal Draw until your next turn (when it casts a chakra-molding jutsu you gain temporary chakra: 1d4 D/C, 1d8 B/A, 1d12 S). Each instance of damage you take +2.
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Maelstrom)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +1d10 damage (half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
